title: ageratina cutervensis
intro: Ageratina cutervensis, commonly known as San Luis or Cutervo, is a plant species in the Lamiaceae family, native to the Andes mountain range in South America. This plant is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects, which can help alleviate symptoms of fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Ageratina cutervensis include its ability to reduce inflammation, relieve pain, and modulate the immune system, making it a valuable resource for traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential uses in the treatment of various health conditions.
